extra_note: Traced 2026-11-18 from the 2026-27 trail map and aerial photos (NAIP); approximate (within about 100 m). The resort reports Village Way in six named sections, which are the six OpenStreetMap ways of Village Way in order from Parsenn Bowl to the village (section names assigned in that order; all green except the Bowl section).
links_note: Jelly Roll is reached by hiking north along the Vasquez Cirque ridge.
